Even the most confidential information arrives almost as an afterthought."''<br />''"Do you ever stop talking?|Vesto Slipher and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="Lockdown" />}}
'''Vesto Slipher''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] field analyst of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Lockdown" /> He was killed in [[Cog Hive Seven]] by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]], when Maul reprogrammed [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]], which sliced Slipher's neck in half.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vesto Slipher appeared in the [[2014]] novel ''[[Maul: Lockdown]]'', written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Lockdown" /> The character shares his name with a real-life [[Wikipedia:Vesto_Slipher|American astronomer]].
